title: A geometrically regular local ring is regular and H_1 of its residue field injects into the cotangent space
statement: Let $k$ be a field of characteristic $p>0$ and $(A,\mathfrak m,K)$ a Noetherian local $k$-algebra [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] which is geometrically regular over $k$ [def-weil-pbc-g-ring]. Then $A$ is a regular local ring [def-weil-regular-scheme] and the canonical $K$-linear map $H_1(L_{K/k})\to\mathfrak m/\mathfrak m^2$ is injective. Here $H_1(L_{K/k})$ and $H_1(L_{K/A})$ are the first homologies of the naive cotangent complexes of the canonical presentations $k[K]\to K$ and $A[K]\to K$ [def-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map]; the inclusion $k[K]\to A[K]$ is a morphism of presentations over the square $k\to A$, $\mathrm{id}_K$, and so induces a map $H_1(L_{K/k})\to H_1(L_{K/A})$ [lem-weil-pbc-nl-presentation-h1-functoriality]; the canonical map is its composite with the isomorphism $H_1(L_{K/A})\cong\mathfrak m/\mathfrak m^2$ of [lem-weil-pbc-jacobi-zariski-surjection-h1] for the surjection $A\to K$.

proof.text: Apply geometric regularity to the trivial finite purely inseparable extension ULift k. Transport regularity of ULift k tensor A through ULift.algEquiv and the tensor left-unit equivalence, then use IsRegularLocalRing.of_isRegularRing_of_isLocalRing to prove the regularity clause.

Apply connecting-map naturality to the prime field, k, A and its maximal ideal. This supplies the comparison c, its tensor differential formula and the identity conormalDifferential composed with theta composed with the H1 map equals c composed with the boundary.

The universal differentials span the absolute differential space. Mathlib exists_linearIndependent' chooses a spanning independent subfamily; Basis.mk makes it a basis and Basis.baseChange makes its residue-field scalar extension a basis. For every finite subset, apply the finite differential-family lemma. Its images under c agree with the stated family by the naturality tensor formula. linearIndependent_iff_finset_linearIndependent and LinearMap.injective_of_linearIndependent give injectivity of c.

Prime-field H1 of the residue field vanishes. In the exact Jacobi-Zariski sequence for the prime field, k and K, a boundary-zero cycle is consequently zero. Given a cycle killed by H1Cotangent.map k A K K, naturality shows c kills its boundary. Injectivity of c gives zero boundary and therefore zero cycle. Finally compose injectivity of this H1 map with injectivity of the original surjection-to-conormal linear equivalence. Algebra structures over the prime field agree by uniqueness; the original theorem signature is unchanged.
